items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I got to know John and hang out with Ernie and John at his castle in Ireland

ctx.x: Well Ernie was very passionate about the music, wasn’t he?

Oh he was just terrific. Oh we hung out many, many, many years later and over the years and we were getting a theater in England together. I mean he turned out to be John Huston’s right hand man, so I got to know John and hang out with Ernie and John at his castle in Ireland, near Galway. And anyway, so I stayed with Joe. They had an extra bed and there was a Marine major about my size and I would casually put his Marine major uniform on and go and have food at the Marine mess hall.
